summary: Frontend-only testing of TipJar Star Threshold Alerts + Promo Banner feature. All 6 requested items verified successfully with zero console errors. Promo banner renders above header, CTA opens bell settings panel, slider updates + persists threshold to localStorage 'tj_bell_min', enable/disable toggle updates 'tj_bell' key correctly, threshold badge (e.g. '5+') appears when alerts on and disappears when off, notification-bell in header opens/closes the same panel, threshold value survives full page reload, 15s polling of /tips + /notifications/stats runs without errors. RateWall showcase (TipJarHQ) present.
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell polling depends on t (i18n) in dependency array — when user switches language mid-session the whole polling effect resets and seen.current is re-initialised, which briefly re-suppresses new-tip notifications. Minor; consider using a ref for t inside pushNotify or splitting effects.
onRef/minRef are assigned during render instead of inside useEffect — works but violates React rules-of-hooks best practice; move to useEffect to avoid subtle issues in Concurrent Mode.
pushNotify() silently swallows all errors — fine for prod but adds a console.debug in dev would help future debugging.
Number(localStorage.getItem('tj_bell_min')) || 8 will coerce a stored '0' to 8; not exposed via slider (min=1) so harmless today, but if slider min changes it could surprise users.
test_credentials: Not needed for this feature (device-based anon id). Admin available in /app/memory/test_credentials.md if required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PromoBanner + NotificationBell threshold-alerts flow is fully working. data-testids: promo-banner, promo-cta, notification-bell, bell-settings-panel, bell-threshold-slider, bell-threshold-value, bell-toggle-btn, bell-threshold-badge. localStorage keys: tj_bell (values '1' or removed), tj_bell_min (integer 1-10, default 8), tj_anon (auto-generated device id). Bell state persists across reload; opening panel via promo CTA uses window Event 'tj-open-alerts'.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Feature works as specified in the review request.
